description:
Skin market index series. The rust.wiki Market Index: a basket of skins rebased to 100 at the start of the window, like a stock
index, built from Steam's daily price history (one point per day; weekly beyond two years). Returns `dates`
(ISO dates), `values` (index level, 100 = the window's first day), `constituent_count` (skins that had a price
at the baseline; baskets are capped at 300 constituents) and `label`. A skin whose history starts inside the
window joins from its first price. Cached for 24 hours per parameter combination (history only gains a point
every 6 hours); the full catalogue, every category and every collection are kept warm server-side.

basket_type.description: Which skins form the index: `all`, `high_value`/`low_value` (300 priciest/cheapest), `category`, `collection`, `color`, `item` (one base item's skins) or `custom` (your own list).

basket_value.description: The category, collection name, colour, item shortname, or for `custom` a comma-separated list of up to 300 itemdefids. Ignored for all/high_value/low_value.

end_date.description: Custom range end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Only read when range=custom.

range.description: Window: `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`, `4y`, `5y`, `all`, or `custom` with `start_date`/`end_date`. Spans over two years are downsampled to one point per week.

start_date.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Only read when range=custom.

trim_days.description: Mask each constituent's first N days of history (0-90) to drop launch-week volatility.

weight_mode.description: `equal`: every constituent's % move counts the same. `marketcap`: weighted by price x Workshop subscribers, like an S&P-style index.

name: get_market_index
title: Skin market index series
